title: Apply to become a student — Green Light Buying Machine
description: For fix-and-flip operators with 10 to 15 projects behind them, anywhere in the country.
heading: Apply to become a student
lede: We accept a small number of operators who already know how to build. Tell us about your work and we'll tell you honestly whether this is the right move for you now.

blocks.aside:
What happens next

  • We read it — a person, not a filter
  • If it's a fit, we set up a call
  • We walk through the full fee schedule
  • If we both want to go ahead, you're accepted
  • Payment comes after that, not before

Before you apply

Applying costs nothing. If you're accepted it's $15,000 to onboard, plus ongoing membership and platform fees we'll go through with you. The house and the renovation are yours to finance, as with any flip.

The fit list is blunt about who this works for.

Not an operator?

If you have a property you think would convert well, send it to us instead. If you're looking to buy a finished home, start here.
